But what’s happened is the opposite. The curve of AI progress is basically going vertical right now, which means if you had codified your processes 3-6 months ago you’re likely already behind again. It’s a time when you will need to be constantly reevaluating the things that didn’t work just a couple months ago to see if they now can be solved.
